commons.description:
These murals are paintings from The Ramakien Gallery, painted on the walls of Wat Phra Kaeo, Thailand. These are originally 18th century murals painted in gold leaf. The paintings represent events from Ramayana, an epic from Indian mythology. 
The painting depicts scene from YuddhaKanda and Sundara Kanda (Chapter on Hanuman and battle from Ramayana)
